classification: Actual child catalog inspection; availability not proof of mutation success

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_create_blob
tools.capability: Create a blob in the repository and return its SHA. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_create_branch
tools.capability: Create a new branch from exactly one existing commit SHA or base ref. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_create_commit
tools.capability: Create a commit pointing to tree_sha with one or more parents. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_create_file
tools.capability: Create a new UTF-8 text file through GitHub's contents API. Returns only the resulting commit SHA, not GitHub's full content/commit payload. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents?apiVersion=2022-11-28#create-or-update-file-contents. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_delete_file
tools.capability: Delete a file through GitHub's contents API. Returns only the resulting commit SHA. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents?apiVersion=2022-11-28#delete-a-file. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_enable_auto_merge
tools.capability: Enable auto-merge for a pull request. This wrapper infers the merge method from repository settings and returns only `success`. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/mutations#enablepullrequestautomerge. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_merge_pull_request
tools.capability: Merge a pull request immediately. Returns GitHub's merge result payload (`sha`, `merged`, `message`). Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/pulls?apiVersion=2022-11-28#merge-a-pull-request. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_update_file
tools.capability: Replace a UTF-8 text file through GitHub's contents API. Returns the resulting commit SHA and content blob SHA. Use `content_sha` for a subsequent sequential update. Do not run update/delete writes for the same path in parallel. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents?apiVersion=2022-11-28#create-or-update-file-contents. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_update_pull_request
tools.capability: Update PR metadata, base branch, or open/closed state. Returns the connector's normalized PR snapshot. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/pulls?apiVersion=2022-11-28#update-a-pull-request. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__github_update_ref
tools.capability: Move a branch ref to a commit, rejecting a mismatched expected_sha. Inspect the new branch head before retrying a rejected lease. This tool is part of plugin `GitHub`.
